source: Vatsal, 16 Sep 2026 (phase 10b-2): the core-action events that no single screen carries, the standard properties every event carries, and the per-event properties of plan_v2.md appendix D
note: standard_properties: on every event in docs/events.html. named_properties: what a named event of the screens data adds (plan_v2.md appendix D), keyed by the exact event name or, for the number-screen set, by the part after the screen's own '<id>_' prefix (set, skip, ...). events: one entry per core-action event with name, fires (when it fires), properties (what it adds beyond the standard ones; empty means standard only), section (the section letter it belongs to, empty when it is app-wide) and cause. scripts/build_events.py renders all of it.

events.name: action_started
events.fires: The client starts an action from the plan on the execution screens (section E).

events.name: action_done
events.fires: An action from the plan is complete. verification says how it was confirmed: aa_verified (seen in the AA fetch) or self_reported (the client marked it done).

events.name: review_opened
events.fires: The client opens a review (section Q).

events.name: review_accepted
events.fires: The client accepts what the review proposes (section Q).

events.name: life_event_reported
events.fires: The client reports a life event on Q06 (also named on Q06 above).

events.name: nudge_sent
events.fires: A nudge on a state's ladder goes out (also named on the N screens above).

events.name: nudge_opened
events.fires: The client opens a nudge (also named on the N screens above).

events.name: open_organic
events.fires: An app open with no nudge_opened in the prior 24 hours.
